data.narrative:
Agile Robots is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Zhaopeng Chen and Peter Meusel, currently valued above $1B after raising approximately $384M. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, reflecting the nascent public-market presence in frontier robotics.

Peer-median analysis applies directly to this stage and sector. A cohort of five same-stage and adjacent-stage robotics companies—Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B, Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B, Series C)—yields a median valuation of $1.6B with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. This method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $1.6B. This aligns closely with Agile Robots' stated >$1B valuation and reflects consensus pricing within the robotics peer set. Key uncertainties include the single-method basis of the triangulation, limited public-market comps, and stage-specific performance differentials among peers. Revenue growth, unit economics, and customer concentration remain critical but unmeasured drivers of relative positioning within this range.
